units.source_text: 几个小时之后，屋里的油灯早已燃尽，除了床上两人的酣睡声和蟋蟀的叫声，万籁俱寂，秋意渐浓。

en.t: Several hours later, the oil lamp in the room had long since burned out; except for the deep sleeping breaths of the two people on the bed and the cries of the crickets, everything was silent, and the feeling of autumn was growing stronger.

units.source_text: 但是，这个时候，金花做了一个很美的梦，

en.t: But at that moment, Jinhua was having a very beautiful dream,

units.source_text: 这美梦就像轻烟一样从布满灰尘的床帐里，飞向高院的星月夜空。

en.t: That beautiful dream, like a wisp of light smoke, flew out from the dust-filled bed curtains and up into the starry, moonlit night sky above the high courtyard.
